source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style critique and feedback channels should provide attributable model-review signal under explicit budget policy; the paper names critique in the front overview, while detailed LLM-feedback and budget/orchestration evidence is in Sections 2.4 and 2.6
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has configured reviewer specs, manifest-safe reviewer names, optional reviewer prompts, reviewer role labels, role backend routing compatibility, role budget accounting compatibility, a bounded synchronous reviewer pool, first-valid and last-valid aggregation, reviewer parser status, valid revision counts, selected reviewer provenance, reviewer elapsed seconds, reviewer outcome status, and inline runtime artifact policy. It does not claim async reviewer overlap, independent reviewer task definitions, reviewer/generator role separation proof, critique-to-revision attribution, reviewer score-to-selection policy, reviewer budget quota policy, reviewer failure-isolation reports, equal-budget no-reviewer comparisons, calibrated reviewer-score reports, reviewer reliability ablations, per-reviewer provider isolation, or external reviewer timeout artifacts.
